h1: Logging and an audit trail for your AI workflows
overview: When something goes wrong, or a customer asks why, you need an answer. We add a logbook to your workflow that records each run: what came in, what the tool produced, which rule applied and who approved it. Entries are stored in a sheet or database you own, time stamped and easy to search. Private details can be masked, and a short guide explains how to read the log.

faq: In a Google Sheet, Airtable base or database in your own account, so you control access. We never keep a copy on our side after delivery.
Will the log store private customer details?
Only what is needed. We can mask names, emails or card digits so the record shows what happened without exposing personal data. You choose the fields.
Does this satisfy a legal audit requirement?
It gives you a clear, time stamped record, which helps. We cannot confirm it meets a specific law or standard, so check your own obligations with an adviser.
Can you add logging to a workflow someone else built?
Usually yes, if we can reach the steps through your accounts. We review it first and tell you what can be recorded before you commit.
